result_summary.title: SSO Integration issues
result_summary.description: Hi, we have problems with the SSO module in staging (LATAM). It seems to be creating duplicate accounts and the provisioning is stuck. Also, the bulk import failed completely. This is affecting around 80 users. Please check.

result_summary.note: Call again with one of these metric_category values to see actual readings.

signals.message: required environment variable missing on Group Sync Service

final_diagnosis.recommended_next_action: Verify SSO configuration and environment variables for Group Sync Service on COMPONENT_FFW
final_diagnosis.evidence_summary: The case report indicates issues with the SSO module in staging (LATAM), including duplicate account creation, provisioning stuck, and bulk import failure. The recommended next action is to verify the SSO configuration and environment variables for the Group Sync Service on COMPONENT_FFW.
